refusal.wall: The Secretary of State's statewide list of clerks and polling places refuses every automated client we can honestly send.

rungs.what: Plain fetch of www.sos.nh.gov/elections/voters
rungs.result: HTTP 403 (Akamai edge denial)

rungs.what: Full browser header set against app.sos.nh.gov
rungs.result: HTTP 403

rungs.what: curl's TLS fingerprint against both hosts
rungs.result: HTTP 403

rungs.what: A second egress (a hosted fetcher outside this network)
rungs.result: HTTP 403 — the refusal is not this IP alone

rungs.what: Live Chromium, JavaScript executed, content awaited
rungs.result: HTTP 403, Akamai 'Access Denied' body

rungs.what: The tool's own network call, recovered from its bundle: ClerkandPolling/GetClerkandPollingList
rungs.result: FOUND and deliberately NOT CALLED — the tool gates it behind reCAPTCHA, and we do not circumvent bot detection

rungs.what: The Secretary of State's own PDFs (election media guides) on sos.nh.gov
rungs.result: HTTP 403 and 503 — the same wall covers documents

rungs.what: Search index for a statewide list
rungs.result: Named the tool at app.sos.nh.gov/statelistclerkandpolling; no machine-readable copy on an authority host

rungs.what: Internet Archive for app.sos.nh.gov
rungs.result: HIT — the archived Angular bundle, which is what gave rung 7 its endpoint name

rungs.what: The vendor platform underneath (Angular SPA behind Akamai)
rungs.result: Identified; the platform exposes no unguarded interface

rungs.what: The Secretary of State's public-records request path
rungs.result: NOT YET WALKED — named here so the next session starts from it rather than from rung 2
